subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Listen to a talk about Western influence on teenagers
Ask questions to get more information

tf.s: The talk is about changing tastes in eating and shopping.
tf.why: Yes! Food and shopping are the two areas in the talk.

tf.s: Omani teenagers like fast food because it is tasty, quick and convenient.
tf.why: Right! They also see the outlets as cool places to meet friends.

tf.s: The speaker says teenagers mostly want rice and fish at fast food outlets.
tf.why: The speaker mentions pizzas and burgers.

tf.s: Teenagers go to malls to copy Western fashions they see on TV and the Internet.
tf.why: Correct! TV and the Internet show them new fashions.

tf.s: According to the talk, teenagers are looking for stylish jeans and fashionable shoes.
'How do you mean?' is used to end a conversation.
tf.why: 'How do you mean?' asks for more explanation.

tf.s: 'Can you give me some examples?' asks for more information.
tf.why: Good! It helps the speaker explain more.
'Convenient' means easy and suitable for you.

tf.s: 'I'm in love with fast food' is a statement about food.
tf.why: Right! It is one of the four teenage statements.

tf.s: Predicting topics from the title is a waste of time before listening.
tf.why: Predicting from the title helps you get ready to listen.

boxes.q: What are the two areas of changing tastes in the talk?
boxes.why: The talk discusses food and shopping.

boxes.q: Which two meals does the speaker mention?
Where do teenagers go to buy Western fashions?
boxes.why: They go to malls to copy fashions.

boxes.q: Where do teenagers see Western fashions?
boxes.why: TV and the Internet show new fashions.
'Can you give me some examples?' asks for details.

boxes.q: Which question asks for more explanation?
boxes.why: It asks the speaker to explain.
Fast food is quick and convenient.

o: a place that sells fast food
boxes.why: An outlet is a shop or restaurant.

o: I can't live without the Internet.
I'm in love with fast food.

hunt.q: Two meals in the talk: pizzas and ___
Place teens go to copy fashions

mcq.q: Why do teenagers see fast food outlets as attractive?
o: they are cool places to hang out with friends
mcq.why: Teens like to meet friends there.

mcq.q: What kind of clothes are teenagers looking for?
o: stylish jeans, fashionable shoes and hats

mcq.q: Which topics could you predict from the title 'Western Influence – Good or Bad?'
Which phrase is a Soundbite for asking questions?
mcq.why: 'Why do you think…?' asks for reasons.

mcq.q: Choose the correct question with 'Why do you think…'.
o: Why do you think teenagers like fast food?
Why you think teenagers likes fast food?
Why do you thinking teenagers like fast food?
Why think you teenagers like fast food?
mcq.why: After 'Why do you think' we use a normal sentence.

mcq.q: Your partner says, 'Clothes are important to me.' Which follow-up question asks for detail?
o: What kind of clothes do you like?
mcq.why: 'What kind of…' asks for more information.

mcq.q: Someone says, 'Tastes are changing.' You don't understand. What do you say?
mcq.why: This question asks the speaker to explain.

mcq.q: Why does the talk link teenagers' shopping to TV and the Internet?
o: Teenagers copy the Western fashions they see there
TV and the Internet sell food
mcq.why: Media shows them new fashions to copy.

mcq.q: Which reason best explains why fast food is popular with busy teenagers?
o: It takes a long time to cook
It is only sold at home
mcq.why: Quick, convenient food suits busy people.

mcq.q: A student says, 'My best friend is my mobile phone.' What does this suggest?
o: Her phone is very important in her life
She has a friend called Mobile
mcq.why: The statement shows how much she uses her phone.
